panels.title: Total Cost
panels.description: Total USD cost incurred by Claude Code API usage over the selected time range. Aggregates spending across all models. Alert thresholds: yellow at $10, red at $50.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Total number of Claude Code sessions started over the selected time range. Helps track overall usage volume and growth trends.

panels.title: Active Time (CLI)
panels.description: Total active time (in seconds) where Claude Code CLI was processing requests over the selected time range. Indicates how much machine time was consumed by the agent.

panels.title: Active Time (You)
panels.description: Total active time (in seconds) attributed to user interaction over the selected time range. Indicates how much time you personally spent interacting with Claude Code.

panels.title: Lines of Code
panels.description: Total lines of code added, modified, or deleted by Claude Code over the selected time range. A proxy metric for development throughput.

panels.title: Commits
panels.description: Total number of git commits made by Claude Code over the selected time range. Reflects code delivery output.

panels.title: API Requests
panels.description: Total number of API requests made to the Claude API over the selected time range, counted from Loki log entries. Useful for tracking API call volume.

panels.title: Cost/1K Output
panels.description: Average cost per 1,000 output tokens over the selected time range, computed as total cost divided by output token count (in thousands). Useful for cost efficiency monitoring. Alert thresholds: yellow at $0.05, red at $0.10.

panels.title: Input Tokens
panels.description: Total number of input tokens sent to the Claude API over the selected time range. High input token counts may indicate large context windows or verbose prompts.

panels.title: Output Tokens
panels.description: Total number of output tokens generated by the Claude API over the selected time range. Reflects the volume of content produced by the model.

panels.title: Cache Read
panels.description: Total number of tokens served from cache reads over the selected time range. Higher cache reads reduce cost and latency.

panels.title: Cache Creation
panels.description: Total number of tokens written to cache over the selected time range. Cache creation incurs a one-time cost but saves on future repeated context.

panels.title: Cache Efficiency
panels.description: Ratio of cache-read tokens to total tokens over the selected time range. Higher is better — values above 80% indicate efficient prompt caching. Alert thresholds: red below 50%, yellow 50–80%, green above 80%.

panels.title: Cost by Model
panels.description: Cost breakdown by model over the selected time range, shown as a horizontal bar gauge. Identifies which models drive the most spending.

panels.title: Tokens by Model
panels.description: Token usage distribution across models displayed as a donut chart. Helps understand which models are consuming the most tokens.

panels.title: Tokens by Type
panels.description: Token usage distribution by type (input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreation) displayed as a donut chart. Useful for understanding the token composition of Claude Code interactions.

panels.title: Active Time Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of active time between CLI (agent processing) and user interaction types, shown as a donut chart. Illustrates how time is split between Claude work and human work.

panels.title: Productivity Ratio
panels.description: Fraction of total active time spent by the Claude CLI (as opposed to user interaction). A higher ratio indicates Claude is doing more of the work. Alert thresholds: red below 50%, yellow 50–80%, green above 80%, super-light-green above 95%.

panels.title: Top 10 Tools
panels.description: Top 10 tools invoked by Claude Code over the selected time range, ranked by usage frequency. Helps understand which capabilities Claude relies on most.

panels.title: Success / Error Rate
panels.description: Success versus error rate of tool calls made by Claude Code over the selected time range. A high error rate may indicate misconfigured tools or repeated failed attempts.

panels.title: Token Usage Over Time
panels.description: Token consumption over time broken down by token type (input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreation). Useful for spotting usage spikes and trends.

panels.title: Token Usage by Model Over Time
panels.description: Token consumption over time broken down by model. Shows which models are active in each time window and how their usage evolves.

panels.title: Cost Over Time
panels.description: API cost accumulation over time in USD. Useful for identifying cost spikes and understanding spending patterns across the day or session.

panels.title: Active Time Over Time
panels.description: Active time over time broken down by type (cli vs user). Helps correlate activity patterns with token usage and cost.

panels.title: Tool Decisions
panels.description: Streaming log view of Claude Code tool decision events from Loki. Each log entry represents a decision made by the agent about which tool to invoke.

panels.title: API Requests
panels.description: Streaming log view of Claude Code API request events from Loki. Shows raw API call logs useful for debugging model interactions.

panels.title: User Prompts
panels.description: Streaming log view of user prompt events from Loki. Displays the prompts submitted by the user to Claude Code in near-real time.
